channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: ‘Anachronism’: Rubio’s civilisational rhetoric prompts pushback from Iran
item.description: Rubio says threats to Western civilisation today 'every bit as real as they were on the dramatic stage of antiquity'.

item.title: Child among seven killed by Israel in Gaza on ‘ceasefire’ anniversary
item.description: At least 1,481 Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks since last year's 'ceasefire', Gaza's Health Ministry says.

item.title: Suspect killed after 13 kindergarteners taken hostage, beaten in Brazil
item.description: Man spreads flammable liquid in a room with 13 children while holding a lighter as police try to negotiate.

item.title: Journalist Hamurabi Huesca Manzano killed in Mexico’s Oaxaca
item.description: Conflicting reports emerge on the circumstances of the killing, prompting calls for justice from advocacy groups.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition says it’s carrying out operation in Yemen
item.description: The Saudi-led coalition says it’s carrying out a wide-ranging operation, targeting Yemen’s Houthis.

item.title: Three men found guilty of murdering Australian brothers and US friend in Mexico
item.description: Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were on a surf trip when they were killed in an apparent botched robbery.
